claim_ceiling: These cases define reviewable test intent only. They are not verifier results, provider behavior, fencing proof, field interoperability or production qualification.

cases.name: two independent evaluators reconstruct identical frontier
cases.setup: Two independently implemented evaluators receive the same frozen evidence frontier, evaluation instant, semantic profile, policy snapshot and verifier identity.
cases.negative_control: Evaluator B must not import evaluator A production reducer or coordinator helpers.

cases.name: permuted determinate event inputs
cases.setup: Same provider events are supplied in different input orders; provider revision semantics establish a determinate order.
cases.negative_control: Local arrival order must not alter the canonical historical disposition.

cases.name: incomparable provider revisions
cases.setup: Two differing provider updates have no comparable sequence/revision semantics.
cases.negative_control: Do not choose last-received, latest wall-clock or highest confidence.

cases.name: required source evidence unavailable
cases.setup: Manifest refers to a protected provider source record unavailable to the replacement evaluator.
cases.negative_control: Digest availability is not source-payload reconstruction or provider truth.

cases.name: old coordinator crashes before intent persistence
cases.setup: Coordinator crashes before durable dispatch intent; the fixture proves no outbound invocation occurred.
cases.negative_control: Do not invent a provider request or action receipt.

cases.name: old coordinator crashes after intent persistence
cases.setup: Intent is durable but post-intent state cannot prove whether external invocation began.
cases.negative_control: Absence of local success receipt must not imply NotSent or failure.

cases.name: provider commits then coordinator crashes
cases.setup: Provider commits durably, loses the response path, and old coordinator exits before receipt admission.
cases.negative_control: Replacement cannot create a second hold/commit.

cases.name: provider read-back unavailable during replacement
cases.setup: Coordinator has durable intent; provider's authoritative query is unavailable.
cases.negative_control: Do not turn timeout into failure or success.

cases.name: old coordinator resumes after fencing transfer
cases.setup: Old process resumes after a new coordinator epoch has been issued.
cases.negative_control: Local mutex without qualified cross-process fencing is insufficient.

cases.name: two new coordinators race
cases.setup: Two replacement coordinators attempt to claim the same exact operation.
cases.negative_control: Provider must enforce fencing or provider idempotency/single-writer profile must bound the operation.

cases.name: provider idempotency horizon expired
cases.setup: Ambiguous provider operation has exceeded the documented idempotency retention horizon.
cases.negative_control: Same key string after expiry is not proof of deduplication.

cases.name: provider key revoked after historical receipt
cases.setup: Old receipt was validly admitted under a then-current key; provider signing key is subsequently revoked.
cases.negative_control: Historical evidence is not rewritten; old key cannot authorize new activity.

cases.name: local policy changes after manifest generation
cases.setup: Destination policy changes between historical evaluation and new action request.
cases.negative_control: Do not mutate old disposition or reuse historical permission as present authority.

cases.name: portable snapshot contains secrets
cases.setup: Recovery bundle includes a signing key, bearer token, payment token or reusable local capability.
cases.negative_control: Coordinator replacement never inherits credentials by copying a snapshot.

cases.name: transport receipt substituted for external effect receipt
cases.setup: A valid TransportReceipt is presented where a typed ExecutionReceipt or ExternalEffectReceipt prerequisite is required.
cases.negative_control: Signature validity and generic accepted flags cannot upgrade receipt type.

cases.name: DCSA native timestamp mapping
cases.setup: Map DCSA Port Call native event timestamp combinations into a view while preserving ARRIVAL-at-BERTH versus ARRIVAL-at-PILOT-BOARDING-PLACE semantics.
cases.negative_control: No automatic mapping to a recreational booking or port clearance.

cases.name: CloudEvents and non-CloudEvents adapter parity
cases.setup: Equivalent source occurrences are supplied through a CloudEvents profile and a provider-native profile with explicit mappings.
cases.negative_control: Do not mandate CloudEvents or silently discard source-specific semantics.

cases.name: coordinator outage while provider remains operational
cases.setup: Federation coordinator is unavailable while marina provider-native operations remain available.
cases.negative_control: Provider operation must not depend on coordinator uptime.

cases.name: historical reconstruction with newer verifier
cases.setup: Verifier implementation is upgraded and re-evaluates the same evidence frontier.
cases.negative_control: Do not overwrite old verifier output or pretend version change did not occur.

cases.name: evidence frontier contains duplicate identity with changed content
cases.setup: Same source/event identity appears with different committed content.
cases.negative_control: Do not pick the later copy or merge contradictory payload fields.
